description: Inventory loading edge cases: single remote host with list roles, a local host marker, ranged host expansion, an inventory containing only hidden template entries, and YAML merge-key reuse of a hidden template.

input.yaml:
web1:
  hostname: web1.example.com
  remote_user: deploy
  port: 2222
  roles:
    - app
    - web

cases.expected_output:
hosts=web1
host.web1.type=remote
host.web1.hostname=web1.example.com
host.web1.roles=["app","web"]
host.web1.remote_user=deploy
host.web1.port=2222
host.web1.ssh_arguments=-p 2222

hosts=node1,node2,node3
host.node1.type=remote
host.node1.hostname=node.example.org
host.node1.roles=worker
host.node2.type=remote
host.node2.hostname=node.example.org
host.node2.roles=worker
host.node3.type=remote
host.node3.hostname=node.example.org
host.node3.roles=worker

input.yaml:
.common: &common
  remote_user: ci
  port: 22
app:
  <<: *common
  hostname: app.example.com

cases.expected_output:
hosts=app
host.app.type=remote
host.app.hostname=app.example.com
host.app.remote_user=ci
host.app.port=22
host.app.ssh_arguments=-p 22
